Allowed origins (`worker/src/index.ts`, `cors()` middleware, lines ~21-34): exact `http://localhost:4200`, plus any subdomain of `.pages.dev` and `.workers.dev` (checked via `origin.endsWith(...)`).

To add a new custom domain: edit the `origin` function inside the `cors({...})` call in `worker/src/index.ts` — add a new exact-match or `endsWith` condition in that `if` block. Per `index.md` and `DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4`, Hono's array form only does exact matches, so wildcard subdomains require this function form.
